class.name: VideoShadowSettingsServer
class.brief_description: Settings server for the shadow atlases (size, bit depth, quadrant subdivisions) and the soft shadow filter quality.

method.name: add_viewport
method.description: Adds a further viewport (for example a [SubViewport] that renders the 3D world) that gets the positional atlas values at once and every later change, like the root viewport. The directional shadow map and the filter qualities are global, not per viewport. A freed viewport is dropped on its own. See also [method get_viewport_group].

method.name: get_directional_shadow_atlas_size
method.description: Returns the pending size of the directional shadow map. See [member VideoShadowSettings.directional_shadow_atlas_size].

method.name: get_directional_soft_shadow_filter_quality
method.description: Returns the pending soft shadow filter quality of directional lights. See [member VideoShadowSettings.directional_soft_shadow_filter_quality].

method.name: get_positional_shadow_atlas_quadrant_subdiv
method.description: Returns the pending subdivision of the quadrant [param quadrant] ([code]0[/code] to [code]3[/code]) of the positional shadow atlas. See [member VideoShadowSettings.positional_shadow_atlas_quad_0].

method.name: get_positional_shadow_atlas_size
method.description: Returns the pending size of the positional shadow atlas. See [member VideoShadowSettings.positional_shadow_atlas_size].

method.name: get_positional_soft_shadow_filter_quality
method.description: Returns the pending soft shadow filter quality of omni and spot lights. See [member VideoShadowSettings.positional_soft_shadow_filter_quality].

method.name: get_unsupported_setting_names
method.description: Returns the names of the values the current renderer ignores, for example to gray out their options in a settings menu. Empty with every current renderer; kept for the same API as the other video domains. See [method SettingsServer.is_value_supported].

method.name: get_viewport_group
method.description: Returns the group [code]&"video_shadow_settings"[/code]. Every [Viewport] in this group gets the positional atlas values when it enters the tree and every later change while it is in the tree, without [method add_viewport].

method.name: has_viewport
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param viewport] was added with [method add_viewport].

method.name: is_directional_shadow_16_bits_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the pending directional shadow map uses 16-bit depth. See [member VideoShadowSettings.directional_shadow_16_bits].

method.name: is_positional_shadow_atlas_16_bits_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the pending positional shadow atlas uses 16-bit depth. See [member VideoShadowSettings.positional_shadow_atlas_16_bits].

method.name: is_renderer_supported
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the current renderer uses the value [param name]. Forward+, Mobile and Compatibility use every value of this domain. Unlike [method SettingsServer.is_value_supported], it does not check that the domain has the value.

method.name: remove_viewport
method.description: Removes a viewport added with [method add_viewport]. It keeps its current values.

method.name: set_directional_shadow_16_bits
method.description: Sets the bit depth of the directional shadow map (setting [code]"directional_shadow_16_bits"[/code]). See [member VideoShadowSettings.directional_shadow_16_bits].

method.name: set_directional_shadow_atlas_size
method.description: Sets the size of the directional shadow map (setting [code]"directional_shadow_atlas_size"[/code]). See [member VideoShadowSettings.directional_shadow_atlas_size].

method.name: set_directional_soft_shadow_filter_quality
method.description: Sets the soft shadow filter quality of directional lights (setting [code]"directional_soft_shadow_filter_quality"[/code]). See [member VideoShadowSettings.directional_soft_shadow_filter_quality].

method.name: set_positional_shadow_atlas_16_bits
method.description: Sets the bit depth of the positional shadow atlas (setting [code]"positional_shadow_atlas_16_bits"[/code]). See [member VideoShadowSettings.positional_shadow_atlas_16_bits].

method.name: set_positional_shadow_atlas_quadrant_subdiv
method.description: Sets the subdivision of the quadrant [param quadrant] ([code]0[/code] to [code]3[/code]) of the positional shadow atlas (settings [code]"positional_shadow_atlas_quad_0"[/code] to [code]"positional_shadow_atlas_quad_3"[/code]). See [member VideoShadowSettings.positional_shadow_atlas_quad_0].

method.name: set_positional_shadow_atlas_size
method.description: Sets the size of the positional shadow atlas (setting [code]"positional_shadow_atlas_size"[/code]). [code]0[/code] disables positional shadows. See [member VideoShadowSettings.positional_shadow_atlas_size].

method.name: set_positional_soft_shadow_filter_quality
method.description: Sets the soft shadow filter quality of omni and spot lights (setting [code]"positional_soft_shadow_filter_quality"[/code]). See [member VideoShadowSettings.positional_soft_shadow_filter_quality].

signal.name: directional_shadow_atlas_size_changed
signal.description: Emitted once when a changed [member VideoShadowSettings.directional_shadow_atlas_size] reached the engine: by [method SettingsServer.apply] (also at startup after the settings file is loaded, and after [method SettingsServer.reset_to_defaults] in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE]), [method SettingsServer.apply_with_confirmation], [method SettingsServer.cancel_confirmation] (with the restored value) or a session override. Not emitted for pending changes in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_MANUAL]; [signal SettingsServer.value_changed] reports those.

signal.name: directional_soft_shadow_filter_quality_changed
signal.description: Emitted once when a changed [member VideoShadowSettings.directional_soft_shadow_filter_quality] reached the engine: by [method SettingsServer.apply] (also at startup after the settings file is loaded, and after [method SettingsServer.reset_to_defaults] in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE]), [method SettingsServer.apply_with_confirmation], [method SettingsServer.cancel_confirmation] (with the restored value) or a session override. Not emitted for pending changes in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_MANUAL]; [signal SettingsServer.value_changed] reports those.

signal.name: positional_shadow_atlas_size_changed
signal.description: Emitted once when a changed [member VideoShadowSettings.positional_shadow_atlas_size] reached the engine: by [method SettingsServer.apply] (also at startup after the settings file is loaded, and after [method SettingsServer.reset_to_defaults] in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE]), [method SettingsServer.apply_with_confirmation], [method SettingsServer.cancel_confirmation] (with the restored value) or a session override. Not emitted for pending changes in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_MANUAL]; [signal SettingsServer.value_changed] reports those. Use it for a [SubViewport] with omni or spot light shadows.

signal.name: positional_soft_shadow_filter_quality_changed
signal.description: Emitted once when a changed [member VideoShadowSettings.positional_soft_shadow_filter_quality] reached the engine: by [method SettingsServer.apply] (also at startup after the settings file is loaded, and after [method SettingsServer.reset_to_defaults] in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE]), [method SettingsServer.apply_with_confirmation], [method SettingsServer.cancel_confirmation] (with the restored value) or a session override. Not emitted for pending changes in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_MANUAL]; [signal SettingsServer.value_changed] reports those.
